  4. types_and_static_semantics (required): implement binding, types, module resolution and exact static errors
  5. dynamic_semantics (required): model values, evaluation, objects, numeric/Unicode behavior and errors
  6. effects_and_concurrency (required): model I/O, ownership, cancellation and source memory ordering
  7. standard_library (required): inventory and implement/version-bind standard libraries and host behavior
  8. typed_ir_lowering (required): lower category-appropriate semantics into versioned USL IR; reject unsupported features
  9. native_backend (required): install compatible real toolchain and execute independent category-specific cases
  10. differential_translation (required): compare values, errors, state, effects and ordering against original runtime
  11. intent_acceptance (required): check independently authored intent contracts, holdouts and applicable formal obligations
  12. abi_interoperability (required): qualify ABI, marshaling, callbacks, GC lifetimes, errors and cancellation
  13. profile_conformance (required): run upstream suites, chapter coverage, property tests and fuzz regressions
  14. platform_performance_safety (required): measure claimed platforms, resources, isolation and supply-chain provenance

  3. grammar_frontend (scoped_subset_evidence_only): implement lexical/parser AST rules and independently check invalid input
  4. types_and_static_semantics (required): implement binding, types, module resolution and exact static errors
  5. dynamic_semantics (required): model values, evaluation, objects, numeric/Unicode behavior and errors
  6. effects_and_concurrency (required): model I/O, ownership, cancellation and source memory ordering
  7. standard_library (required): inventory and implement/version-bind standard libraries and host behavior
  8. typed_ir_lowering (scoped_subset_evidence_only): lower category-appropriate semantics into versioned USL IR; reject unsupported features; preserve category-specific structure/rendering/query/validation rather than infer arbitrary code execution
  9. native_backend (available_host_requires_exact_task_validation): install compatible real toolchain and execute independent category-specific cases
  10. differential_translation (scoped_subset_evidence_only): compare values, errors, state, effects and ordering against original runtime; preserve category-specific structure/rendering/query/validation rather than infer arbitrary code execution
  11. intent_acceptance (scoped_subset_evidence_only): check independently authored intent contracts, holdouts and applicable formal obligations
  12. abi_interoperability (required): qualify ABI, marshaling, callbacks, GC lifetimes, errors and cancellation
  13. profile_conformance (required): run upstream suites, chapter coverage, property tests and fuzz regressions
  14. platform_performance_safety (required): measure claimed platforms, resources, isolation and supply-chain provenance
  15. independent_certification (required): obtain independent scoped review of the exact build and retained limitations
